text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Sweep Tosho takes 1st!
It's Sweep Tosho!
She puts on a display of overwhelming power!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Wooooaaaaah!)

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ...Ah-ah, I lost.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: B-But it's still so frustratinggg!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I was going all out for the win, too~!
Kh... Grr, guhhh~~!

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text: ! Heh, ahaha.

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Then let's challenge it again.
...As many times as it takes!

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text: "Because as long as we keep challenging ourselves, as long as we keep moving forward! Our path will never end!!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hmph... That'll do.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: And with that, I'm gonna make the whole world overflow with even more excitement!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Then beyond that, and far into the future,
the times ahead will just keep getting more and more fun!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...I kind of like that sort of thing.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Alright, decided.
We're heading back, Vodka!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You heading home already?
You've still got interviews left, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure! If Senpai is blazing a trail into the future, I can't afford to lose!
I'll pioneer a path even further ahead!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: First place belongs to me!!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...! Haha, honestly, Scarlet...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Wait up! I'll be the one to blaze a new trail first!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Like hell I'm gonna let you
play nice with everyone else except me!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. Everyone's so full of energy~♪
We~ll then, guess it's about time I—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe I'll go run in a place
where miracles happen instead of magic."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Sweep-san, which race are you running next?!
I will enter as well,
so please tell me quickly!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Be quiet already!
At least let me get some rest!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh?! No, no, no waay~!
Right now, I am completely fired up for a rematch~!

text_block_list.name: Light-Blue-Ribbon Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, Kawakami-san's throwing a tantrum
just like Sweep-san!
choice_data_list: I see, like master, like student…!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Haaah!? Even my familiar is turning on me?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the little witch continues walking her own path
cheerfully alongside her friends.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And surely, she will weave new magic into the world once more.
This time, with the Umamusume of a new era.
